reel.caption:
What tax do you pay on a ₹12.75 lakh salary? Under the new regime, it can be ₹0.

Salaried people get a ₹75,000 standard deduction, so ₹12.75 lakh becomes ₹12 lakh taxable.
Taxable income up to ₹12 lakh gets a full rebate, so the tax is zero. A little above, marginal relief can apply.
Other income such as interest or capital gains changes the maths.

What did you guess?

Sources: two income tax calculator guides for FY 2026-27. Figures assume salary is the only income and are illustrative.
